name: UNILOG_DISABLE
description: 1 disables all capture; logger becomes a no-op

name: UNILOG_MODE
description: auto | full | sidecar | off — auto detects a foreign logger and switches to sidecar

name: LOG_LEVEL
description: threshold: canonical name, 1-24, OFF/NONE, or a runtime-native level name

name: LOG_STDERR_MIN_SEVERITY
description: severity_number at/above which console sink writes stderr instead of stdout; OFF = all stdout, 0 = all stderr

name: LOG_SINK
description: comma list: console, syslog, http, file

name: LOG_SYSLOG_ADDRESS
description: unix:///dev/log (default when reachable) | udp://host:port | tcp://host:port

name: LOG_SYSLOG_FACILITY
description: syslog facility name (local0..7, user, daemon, ...)

name: LOG_SYSLOG_MAX_BYTES
description: truncate syslog payload to this many bytes, keeping valid JSON

name: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
description: resource.service.name; takes precedence over OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES

name: OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES
description: key1=value1,key2=value2 (percent-encoded); malformed value drops the whole var

name: LOG_ENV
description: resource.deployment.environment.name (unilog-specific, no OTel equivalent)

name: LOG_SERVICE_VERSION
description: resource.service.version override

name: LOG_SERVICE_NAMESPACE
description: resource.service.namespace override

name: LOG_INSTANCE_ID_STRATEGY
description: auto | uuid | host-pid | none

name: LOG_RESOURCE_PROCESS
description: include resource.process.pid

name: LOG_RESOURCE_CONTAINER
description: off | auto — read container.id from /proc/self/cgroup

name: LOG_BODY_LIMIT
description: max bytes for body before truncation

name: LOG_MAX_ATTRIBUTES
description: max attribute count per record before dropped_attributes_count

name: LOG_MAX_ATTRIBUTE_BYTES
description: max bytes per attribute value before truncation

name: LOG_MAX_RECORD_BYTES
description: hard cap on serialized record size; lowered to PIPE_BUF automatically when needed

name: LOG_ATOMIC_PIPE
description: auto | 1 | 0 — cap record size to PIPE_BUF(4096) when stdout is a shared pipe

name: LOG_STACKTRACE_MIN_SEVERITY
description: severity_number at/above which exception.stacktrace is attached

name: LOG_EXCEPTION_MAX_CAUSES
description: max unwrapped exception.causes[] entries

name: LOG_REDACT
description: 1 enables key/value redaction (default on — see spec/redaction.default.json)

name: LOG_REDACT_PROFILE
description: default | pii — pii additionally masks email/phone/ip/name

name: LOG_REDACT_MODE
description: mask | drop | hash — hash requires LOG_REDACT_HASH_KEY

name: LOG_REDACT_HASH_KEY
description: HMAC key for LOG_REDACT_MODE=hash

name: LOG_REDACT_STACKTRACE
description: apply value-pattern redaction inside exception.stacktrace too

name: LOG_REDACT_ALLOW
description: comma list of key segments exempted from default redaction

name: LOG_ASCII_ONLY
description: 1 escapes non-ASCII as \\uXXXX instead of raw UTF-8

name: LOG_DEBUG
description: 1 prints unilog's own diagnostics (resolver misses, re-arm events) to stderr
